name: Comprehensive Certificate in Economics

capstone: Choose a consequential economic decision or policy question. Define the economic mechanism and competing hypotheses; assemble a transparent dataset; produce descriptive analysis and an econometric or causal design; stress-test assumptions and uncertainty; incorporate strategic, behavioral or institutional forces; quantify welfare, business or distributional tradeoffs; and deliver a reproducible notebook plus an executive or policy memo with a decision and limitations.
evidence_standard: Explicit assumptions; correct use of micro/macro concepts; reproducible data preparation; statistically coherent estimates; clear distinction between correlation and causation; uncertainty and robustness; strategic and behavioral reasoning where relevant; quantitative tradeoffs; and communication that states what the evidence does and does not support. RELEASE QUALITY STANDARD: long-form academic instruction, reproducible evidence, explicit limitations and a capstone artifact that can be inspected - not just claimed.
